def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Refine cell masks with MobileSAM.")
    ap.add_argument(
        "--weights_path",
        type=str,
        required=True,
        help="Path to MobileSAM weights (mobile_sam.pt)",
    )
    ap.add_argument(
        "--output_path",
        type=str,
        required=True,
        help="Output folder (or .csv file path) for refined masks",
    )
    ap.add_argument("--rgb_path", type=str, required=True, help="Path to RGB image")
    ap.add_argument("--csv_path", type=str, required=True, help="Path to metadata csv")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
